messages:
anya-docs: Quick FYI — opened a docs PR to tidy region availability wording and fix the SDK header example. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/987

marta-sdk: taking a look now. Is the issue just the header name and missing residency note?

anya-docs: Mostly wording and one code sample that sets the header incorrectly for EU residency. Also a legal footnote needs the exact phrase we agreed with Sam.

sam-legal: thanks. The legal-approved phrase is: \"Data processed in the EU will be handled per our EU Data Processing Addendum and may be routed to EU-only infrastructure when the customer opts into Data Residency.\" Please paste that into the footnote rather than paraphrasing.

anya-docs: pasted it in the PR description and added a comment in the docs file where the footnote goes.

marta-sdk: found the snippet. current sample sets `Region: eu-central` as an HTTP header — that's not what our SDK sets. It should be `X-Redwood-Region: eu` and optional `X-Residency-Request: strict`. Suggest replacing the example with this: 

```javascript
// prefer SDK helper to set residency headers
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.generate("Hello world", { headers: { \"X-Redwood-Region\": \"eu\", \"X-Residency-Request\": \"strict\" } });
```

marta-sdk: I'll push a suggested patch to the PR with that snippet.

lee-ux: small copy note — can we avoid the phrase \"EU-only infrastructure\" in the user-facing page? it confuses customers about on-prem. maybe \"EU-hosted infrastructure\" is clearer.

sam-legal: \"EU-hosted infrastructure\" works for legal.

anya-docs: updated the copy per Lee and Sam. Also added an inline callout under the example: \"Note: Residency header requests are honored subject to customer plan and regional capacity.\"

doc-bot: PR #987 by anya-docs — docs/regions/residency.md updated (3 files changed). CI: docs-lint, linkcheck queued.

ci-bot: docs-lint failed on 1 file — line 78: long line (>120 chars). linkcheck passed.

marta-sdk: I'll fix the long line when I push the snippet change.

anya-docs: thanks — can we also add a small migration note for the old header name? some customers still use `Region` header. Recommend: \"Deprecated header `Region` will be accepted for a grace period but please migrate to `X-Redwood-Region`.\"

marta-sdk: added the migration blurb and pushed commit. PTAL. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/987/files#diff-3

sam-legal: quick scan — LGTM for legal text. One nit: change \"grace period\" to \"transition period\".

anya-docs: changed to \"transition period\" and updated the footnote timestamp.

ci-bot: docs-lint passed. doc-bot: merging after 1 approving review from docs.

lee-ux: Approved. Small thumbs up for copy clarity. :thumbsup:

marta-sdk: Approved. I'll follow up with a corresponding snippet in the SDK repo to expose a helper `setResidency()` so docs examples stay small.

anya-docs: Thanks everyone — merging now. Will follow up if any downstream SDK PRs need linkbacks.

doc-bot: Merged PR #987 — closed.
